title: Unit Event — To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream — Episode4 A Strange Sensation

meta.Event: To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream
meta.Event Outline: Following their New Year's performance, everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime returns to their daily lives. During this time, Emu hears that Tsukasa's going to enroll in a workshop and is happy to hear that he's taking a step towards making his dream come true, but...

rows.Line: The next day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, nice work today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, our practice couldn't have gone better!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are you gonna work on assignments for your workshop after this, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, we weren't given any assignments...
But I would like to practice for the performance we'll be doing on the last day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The performance on the last day...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Also, that reminds me.
Apparently, on the last day, we're supposed to put on a performance at a small auditorium that's being rented out for this workshop.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And we're allowed to invite guests, so I hope you'll come by to watch!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Yeah, he mentioned that...
And that time, I...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! We get to see your guys' show?! This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But now, I...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Practice for it? Does that mean you know what you'll be performing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, however... You'll have to wait until the day of to find out.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? You're not gonna tell us?
Did the director tell you guys not to or something...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, this is my own decision!
Because that makes things more interesting!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, I guess...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think it's a nice way to build up the excitement.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
See?! Exactly!
So, here are your platinum tickets to see the show...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, Nene, here you are... And...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is yours, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Get ready to see an incredible performance! I guarantee that you won't be disappointed!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I can't wait to see how you perform your role, Tsukasa☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Yeah, this is fine...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm happy that Tsukasa's learning so much and becoming a better actor.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (So, I should be happy for him as he chases after his dream...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (There's no time for me to feel sad or lonely because I know the day is coming when we have to go our separate ways...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It's coming, so...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Look at me...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (This is supposed to be a happy moment... I wish I could just accept it.)
Several dozen minutes later
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's already this late.
I feel like time's been moving very fast recently.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...
Um, Rui? About Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, something seems to be bothering her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So you noticed too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think a part of her doesn't like how Tsukasa is performing somewhere other than the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She didn't seem to be her usual self when you and I mentioned that it could be fun to go elsewhere to learn more about theatre and acting.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I doubt that she's against the idea of us performing elsewhere... I mean, she was all for Tsukasa attending that workshop when he first told us about it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
True...
She even said that she was looking forward to seeing his show at the end.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, what's going on...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is just my guess...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I think Emu's starting to see that we won't be able to stay together as we take steps towards making each of our dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Is that why...?
She's sad about us going our separate ways?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's what I suspect.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But that's way down the road, and that's life, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your words say one thing, but your face says different.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: D-Don't stare at me like that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For all we know, that time may be coming sooner than we realize...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, this is a tough one...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As much as I'd like to cheer Emu up, there's no clear solution to this problem.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But we can't just leave her like this.
There has to be something we can do for her.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, what would be best for her...?

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line: <Rui!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Len...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, Nene's here too!
Sorry for dropping in without any notice!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <KAITO wants to ask you some directing questions regarding our next show, Rui, so he asked me to come get you.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Is something wrong...?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And we're sorta not sure what to do about it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you mind if we talked to all of you about it? Also, I'll be more than happy to help KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Okay!
Then, I'll let the others know!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <We'll be waiting for you guys in SEKAI!>
